title: QL: Propagate nullability constraints across conjunctions

timeline.body:
IsNull/IsNotNull inside a conjunction influences other operations done
on the same expression:

f > 10 AND f IS NULL -> f IS NULL
IFNULL(f + 1, f - 1) AND f IS NOT NULL -> f + 1 AND f IS NOT NULL

Fix #70683
Moved this code here since I found the existing loop quite inefficient - make a stream to create extraction to put into an array to pass it to a method that does another looping to do basic checks...

timeline.message:
QL: Propagate nullability constraints across conjunctions

IsNull/IsNotNull inside a conjunction influences other operations done
on the same expression:

f > 10 AND f IS NULL -> f IS NULL
IFNULL(f + 1, f - 1) AND f IS NOT NULL -> f + 1 AND f IS NOT NULL

Fix #70683
timeline.author: Costin Leau
Costin Leau

timeline.body: Isn't this also changing the way a projection is now returned when it comes to conjunctions with `NULL`able and `IS NULL` expressions? `SELECT LENGTH(NULL) > 10 AND NULL IS NULL` returns now `NULL`, after this PR I think is returning `TRUE`.

reply.body: Good point - the rule is too aggressive and needs adjusting and only return null as there's another one that can pick up and reduce the null accordingly.

timeline.body: This assertion is also duplicated two lines below.
Looks good in general. Would be worth adding some integration tests as well?

+
+
+//
+// IS NULL/IS NOT NULL propagation
+//
+
+isNullAndComparisonOnTheSameField
+SELECT emp_no IS NULL FROM "test_emp" WHERE emp_no IS NULL AND emp_no > 10;
+
+isNotNullAndComparisonOnTheSameField
+SELECT emp_no IS NULL FROM "test_emp" WHERE emp_no IS NOT NULL AND emp_no IS NULL;
+
+nullifyFieldExpression
+SELECT emp_no + 1 FROM "test_emp" WHERE (emp_no + 2) / 1 + 10 % 3 > 100 AND emp_no IS NULL;
+
+nullifyCoalesceInSelectAndFilter
+SELECT COALESCE(null, ABS(emp_no) + 1, 123) AS c FROM test_emp WHERE emp_no IS NULL ORDER BY c NULLS FIRST LIMIT 5;
+
+
